ns2:course.label: Land Use Planning Workshop
ns2:course.description: Small group field work applying principles and techniques to specific land use problems in selected jurisdictions. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: UP 211, senior or graduate standing, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: UP 211, senior or graduate standing, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman, Sophomore, or Junior class standing.
